title: A Sovereign, Indic-First, Reasoning Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.15371v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gnani-Evon-v3.3-30B-A3B is a long-context hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts model for reasoning, instruction following, and tool use in English and eight Indian languages. Starting from NVIDIA's Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B checkpoint, it retains the 52-layer backbone and changes the vocabulary, training data, and post-training objectives. An in-place expansion from 131,072 to 163,072 tokens reduces mean Indian-language fertility by 38.6%. The new embedding rows are initialized from their upstream decompositions and warmed before the backbone is updated. Continual pretraining then adds broad English-Indic data, high-quality annealing, and direct training at a 131,072-token sequence length.   The central result appears after post-training. translated_title: 一个主权自主、印度语言优先的推理模型
translated_abstract: Gnani-Evon-v3.3-30B-A3B 是一个面向英语和八种印度语言的长上下文混合 Mamba-Transformer 混合专家模型，用于推理、指令遵循和工具使用。该模型从 NVIDIA 的 Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B 检查点出发，保留了 52 层主干网络，并修改了词表、训练数据和后训练目标。将词表从 131,072 个 token 原地扩展至 163,072 个 token，使印度语言的平均分词碎片率降低了 38.6%。新增的嵌入行由其上游分解初始化，并在主干网络更新之前进行预热。随后通过持续预训练加入了广泛的英语-印度语数据、高质量退火，以及 131,072 token 序列长度的直接训练。核心成果出现在后训练阶段：跨四个可验证任务环境的强化学习提升了数学、研究生水平科学和指令遵循能力，但由于相关原因导致印度语抽取式问答性能下降（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出 Gnani-Evon-v3.3-30B-A3B，一个面向英语和八种印度语言的长上下文混合 Mamba-Transformer 混合专家推理模型，通过词表原地扩展使印度语言分词碎片率降低 38.6%，并结合持续预训练与跨可验证任务环境的强化学习提升推理、指令遵循和工具使用能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Gnani-Evon-v3.3-30B-A3B, a long-context hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts reasoning model for English and eight Indian languages, which reduces Indian-language token fertility by 38.6% via in-place vocabulary expansion and enhances reasoning, instruction following, and tool use through continual pretraining and reinforcement learning across verifiable task environments.
